test/substrates/sqlite/invocations/persistence.test.ts#SqliteInvocationPersistence transaction scope [C13-RECEIPT-ATTEMPT-CHAIN] fails closed when an Attempt Receipt loses or changes its source attempt projection

remainingEvidence: AttemptReceipt carries no failure field: src/invocations/receipt.ts#requireAttemptReceipt admits only id, attempt, outcome, previous, and result. Closure requires a closed AttemptFailureKind, its versioned Receipt codec, and rejection of a failed Receipt naming no kind or a non-failed Receipt naming one

Every kind is an AgentCoreError throw rather than a recorded outcome today: src/errors.ts#AgentCoreErrorCode spreads the distinction across operation.invalid-output, actor.closed, facet.inactive, lease.invalid, and turn.invalid-state, and names nothing for an elapsed bound. Closure requires the mediated pipeline to classify at the seam that observes each kind instead of propagating the throw

outputInvalid has a producer only inside one profile wire path: src/facets/profile-runtime/runtime.ts validates a resolved value against contract.descriptor.output and throws operation.invalid-output. Closure requires that verdict to reach the attempted Receipt for every Operation, not only profile-hosted ones

deadline has no producer at all. Closure requires a host-set bound on a claimed attempt whose elapse is distinguishable from ItemClaim expiry recovery, because an expired claim with an existing EffectAttempt already follows Receipt reconciliation
The adversarial case must prove an invoked Operation cannot author any kind but raised, matching the §7.1 rule that a classification the callee supplies never lowers what the host derives

No behaviour may change when a kind is recorded. Closure requires src/invocations/outcome.ts#deriveBatchOutcome, the supersession lineage in src/invocations/receipt.ts, and the next-ordinal rule to be shown reading outcome alone and never the failure field

The indeterminate boundary is unenforced because no kind exists yet. Closure requires a negative case proving a host holding an unknown result records indeterminate with no kind, and that the superseding final Receipt from reconciliation is the first record permitted to name one
PreEffectReceipt must remain the sole evidence that no effect was attempted. Closure requires the Receipt codec and both persistence layers to reject a pre-effect Receipt carrying a failure kind

Admission independence has no enforcement point: no §3.4 rule 7 comparison input is derived from Receipt state today, so closure requires a check proving the failure field is absent from every admission input rather than merely unread
